verdict.rationale: SolidJS's core value proposition is fine-grained reactivity with automatic dependency tracking and a render-once component model, avoiding virtual DOM diffing entirely (solid-gh-1, solid-gh-9, solid-gh-10, solid-gh-14), and this is corroborated by independent community reports of superior performance and 'next level' DOM efficiency (solid-comm-1, solid-comm-2, solid-comm-9, solid-comm-19). Missing for 10: explicit compiler-to-real-DOM-instructions documentation detail and a benchmark citation directly comparing to virtual-DOM diffing overhead.
